parameters.name: freeze_panes

parameters.description: Mapping from unique predictor names to aligned Network snapshots; all dyads include absent edges as zero.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: 'weight' uses aggregate strengths; 'binary' uses edge presence.

parameters.name: include_loops
parameters.description: Include diagonal dyads; False excludes them.

parameters.name: permutations
parameters.description: Uniform node permutations per coefficient-specific reduced-model residual test; plus-one p-values.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Private CPU Torch random seed; predictor names and node labels use canonical order.

parameters.name: alternative
parameters.description: 'two-sided' compares absolute partial correlations; 'greater' and 'less' use the signed statistic.

parameters.name: intercept
parameters.description: Fit a constant; the constant receives no fabricated permutation test.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: 'freedman_lane' permutes reduced response residuals; 'dsp' permutes focal predictor residuals and projects nuisance effects again.

parameters.name: joint
parameters.description: Named coefficient subsets tested together, conditional on remaining predictors; upper-tail partial R-squared.

parameters.name: adjustment
parameters.description: 'none', 'bonferroni', 'holm' or 'bh' over all reported slopes and joint hypotheses; the intercept is excluded.

parameters.name: max_work
parameters.description: Explicit complete-test structural work budget; no partial permutation p-values.

parameters.name: interactions
parameters.description: ``"none"`` (main effects only) or a list such as ``[["a", "b"]]`` or ``["a#b"]``; a covariate may appear in an interaction. An interaction needs the effects it contains in the model (``a#b#c`` needs ``a#b``, ``a#c`` and ``b#c``; ``a#b#x`` needs ``a#x`` and ``b#x``), otherwise ``invalid_spec``.

parameters.name: within
parameters.description: ``oe.rm_anova`` with ``factors`` as between-subject factors (Type III, all between-subject interactions; covariates, ``emmeans`` and other values of ``ss_type`` or ``interactions`` are rejected).

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: ``oe.rm_anova`` with ``factors`` as between-subject factors (Type III, all between-subject interactions; covariates, ``emmeans`` and other values of ``ss_type`` or ``interactions`` are rejected).

parameters.name: emmeans

parameters.name: tsu_strata
parameters.description: Typed terminal sampling-stratum identity within each observed SSU; cells independently select terminal TSUs.

parameters.name: tsu_frame
parameters.description: Complete positive terminal-cell frame for every observed SSU; role keys strata when declared, psu, ssu_strata, ssu, tsu_strata and population_tsu. Every positive cell must have sampled rows. Supplied inputs cannot authenticate a cell omitted externally.

parameters.name: population_ssu
parameters.description: Exact SSU population count constant within each second-stage cell; not a pooled PSU count.

parameters.name: population_tsu
parameters.description: Exact TSU population count within each terminal sampling cell, not a pooled SSU count.
